_provenance.what: Canonical top-level element order for AxDataEntityView, as emitted by the D365FO metadata serializer.
_provenance.why: The deserializer silently drops mis-ordered or unknown elements, so a green build proves nothing about order. This list is the VM-free oracle for tests/tools/dataEntityXml.test.ts.
_provenance.derivation: Every top-level element (lines matching /^\t<Name>/) was read from all 5899 shipped AxDataEntityView*.xml files under K:/AosService/PackagesLocalDirectory/*/*/AxDataEntityView/. Pairwise before/after counts were tallied; the order below has ZERO pairwise violations across all 5899 files.
_provenance.shape: The serializer emits: Name, SourceCode, then base-class properties alphabetically, then AxDataEntityView properties alphabetically, then collections alphabetically. NoYes/enum properties left at their default are omitted entirely (no shipped file writes <IsPublic>No</IsPublic>, and EntityCategory=Master — the enum default — appears in 0 of 5899).
